cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor roller-skating rink during a quiet afternoon — celebrating a cautious first glide by offering a small wave and laughing softly at her own nervous confidence; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — chest-deep in the water; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small private sleeper-train cabin at dawn — savoring the first teaspoon of honey in a warm breakfast while the train passes misty fields; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a street food stall at night under a tarp — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — brings a cup to her lips; her bedroom — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck
